description: This file contains core logic for applying moves to a chess position, deriving game state, and representing the result of a move application. It defines a data class for move results and functions to manipulate and analyze chess positions, likely as part of a larger chess application or engine.

classes.name: AppliedMove
classes.description: Dataclass representing the result of applying a move, including the FEN before and after the move, move notation, and game status.

methods.name: chess.Board _board_from_fen_or_startpos(fen: str)
methods.description: Creates a chess.Board object from a FEN string or the 'startpos' indicator.

methods.name: str _status_from_board(board: chess.Board)
methods.description: Determines the game status (checkmate, stalemate, draw, active) based on the board state.

methods.name: AppliedMove apply_move(fen: str, *, uci: Optional[str], san: Optional[str])
methods.description: Applies a move specified by UCI or SAN notation to a given position, returning the resulting move details and game status.

methods.name: Tuple[str,bool] derive_turn_and_check(fen: str)
methods.description: Returns which player's turn it is ('w' or 'b') and whether the king is in check for the given position.

ctags.name: apply_move
ctags.pattern: /^def apply_move(fen: str, *, uci: Optional[str], san: Optional[str]) -> AppliedMove:$/
